preregistration: this file, committed before any generation (record-first). Owner directive 12-Oct-2026, in-session: 'There will need to be a test of skill vs bare opus 5.5. And also bare sonnet 5.5.' Owner answers the same day: all four measured skills; author 2+ new evals per skill so G>=8 is reachable; spend cap $100. This is also ADR 0095's first batched re-measure.
hypothesis: Neutral (ADR 0059): for each of the four measured skills, appending the skill body to the system prompt may raise, lower, or leave unchanged the graded fraction of expectations met, versus the same model with no skill, on Claude Opus 5.5 and on Claude Sonnet 5.5. A null, a harmful result, or a model-dependent result are equally valid recorded outcomes.

arms.without: claude -p --model <M> --effort medium, isolation flags (--tools "", --disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config, shared deny list), empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, cwd outside the checkout; task text on stdin
arms.with: without + --append-system-prompt = treatments/<skill>.txt (live SKILL.md body at source_sha, frontmatter stripped)

effort: medium for both models (the harness's historical default; Opus 5.5's API default; one step below Sonnet 5.5's API default). Pinned so the model is the only thing that varies across the model factor.
isolation_changes_vs_2026-07: Two defects found and fixed before this run, both symmetric across arms but both inflating the bare arm's context: (1) hermetic_driver.neutral_cwd nested the cwd inside the checkout, so the repo CLAUDE.md auto-loaded into every arm (fixed in the lib, with a test); (2) without --tools "" and --disable-slash-commands this environment offers account-synced copies of these same skills to the bare arm. July baselines are therefore not the same instrument; no sharpening trend is read across them (ADR 0095 decision 4).

evals.source: evals/<skill>.json, frozen by prep.py from skills/<skill>/evals/evals.json
evals.diff_vs_baseline: ids 1-6 unchanged; ids 7-10 added per skill (16 total), authored by a separate agent instructed not to read any repository file, given only each skill's one-line public description, and told to write outcome expectations, never vocabulary or structure. Added verbatim, unedited.
evals.overlap_317: overlap.json (trigram containment of expectations in the skill's own corpus minus cross-skill baseline). Original ids 1-6 excess: +0.008..+0.026; blind ids 7-10: +0.000..+0.007.

prescreen.rule: 1 bare rep per eval per model, graded BEFORE any with-arm cell. Bare fraction-met >= 0.85 = saturated -> dropped for that model only. 0.0 floors flagged, kept. Prescreen cells are never reused in the grid (selecting on bare score and reusing it would bias the delta).
prescreen.g_floor: a (skill, model) with fewer than 8 surviving evals still runs, labelled DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY: it may retire or mark a claim UNDERPOWERED, never discharge debt for a KEEP (ADR 0095 decision 4)

pilot.rule: 2 with-arm cells per model on the first eval; per-model per-cell cost = mean of the pilot and prescreen cells for that model; grid refused if projected > remaining ceiling (ADR 0073)

grid: surviving evals x {with, without} x {opus, sonnet} x 2 reps; at most 40 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 320 cells
judging: Claude Opus 5.5 judge, isolated identically, rubric.skill_grade_prompt per cell. Same family as the generators: every verdict here is FRAME-UNCHECKED (ADR 0093) and may not be promoted to a README KEEP until a cross-family judge (grok) grades the same committed cells via `grade.py --judges grok` and agrees. Self-preference risk is largest on the Opus cells; it affects both arms of a pair alike, so it biases levels more than deltas.
metrics: per (skill, model): eval-clustered mean of (with - without) fraction-met, mean over reps within eval; benchstats.keep_verdict (KEEP iff 95% t-interval lower bound > 0, HARMFUL iff upper < 0, else INCONCLUSIVE; practical bar 0) plus mde80. Primary: the 8 (skill, model) verdicts. Descriptive only, no verdict: the opus-vs-sonnet difference in deltas per skill.
multiplicity: 8 primary intervals at 95% each, no correction: about 0.4 false KEEP/HARMFUL calls expected under a global null. Stated, not corrected, so a single marginal call is read with that in mind.

cost.estimate_basis: isolated probes 12-Oct: a short Sonnet 5.5 call cost $0.011 with ~2.7k tokens of context (July cells carried ~224k cached tokens). List prices: Opus 5.5 $4/$20 per MTok, Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10. Filled from measured prescreen + pilot cells before the grid.

aborted_runs.why: Child calls inherited the parent cloud session's environment (CLAUDE_CODE_*/CCR_*/SESSION_INGRESS_*). Measured: the child reported the parent's session id; concurrent cells hung for 10+ minutes and then 46 of 80 exited 1 with empty stderr; and a 'bare' call reported the parent's attribution and user-email reminders in its context. Fixed in hermetic_driver.build_env (parent-session variables stripped, auth kept; test pins it). No cell from this dir is graded or used; kept for the record only.
